summary: Liberty Defense Holdings filed a Form 6-K furnishing a September 16, 2026 press release announcing a commercial multi-site HEXWAVE agreement. A third-party logistics, warehousing and manufacturing provider will deploy two HEXWAVE concealed-weapon detection systems at one U.S. facility in 2026, with additional systems projected for a second facility in 2027, acquired under Liberty's financing option. Financial terms were not disclosed and no advisor was named. The filing is an ordinary commercial customer-win disclosure, not a special situation; watch for follow-on order conversion and recurring service revenue, with no deal terms to arbitrage.
